svg.aria-label: Quadratus lumborum and psoas major (anterior view) — 腰方肌与腰大肌（前面观）

text.aria-label: Quadratus lumborum and psoas major (anterior view) — 腰方肌与腰大肌（前面观）
text.tspan: Quadratus lumborum and psoas major (anterior view)
腰方肌与腰大肌（前面观）

text.aria-label: Psoas major (right side) — 腰大肌（右侧）
Quadratus lumborum (left side) — 腰方肌（左侧）
Origin → insertion — 起点 → 止点
Origin: bodies and discs T12–L4, transverse processes L1–L5 — 起点：T12–L4 椎体和椎间盘、L1–L5 横突
text.tspan: Origin: bodies and discs T12–L4, transverse processes L1–L5
起点：T12–L4 椎体和椎间盘、L1–L5 横突

text.aria-label: Insertion: lesser trochanter of the femur — 止点：股骨小转子
text.tspan: Insertion: lesser trochanter of the femur

text.aria-label: Origin: iliac crest and iliolumbar ligament — 起点：髂嵴和髂腰韧带
text.tspan: Origin: iliac crest and iliolumbar ligament

text.aria-label: Insertion: 12th rib and L1–L4 transverse processes — 止点：第 12 肋和 L1–L4 横突
text.tspan: Insertion: 12th rib and L1–L4 transverse processes
止点：第 12 肋和 L1–L4 横突

text.aria-label: Both muscles are paired; each is drawn on one side. — 两块肌肉都左右成对，图中各画一侧。
text.tspan: Both muscles are paired; each is drawn on one side.
两块肌肉都左右成对，图中各画一侧。

text.aria-label: Quadratus lumborum outline comes from the 3D model. — 腰方肌轮廓取自 3D 模型。
text.tspan: Quadratus lumborum outline comes from the 3D model.
腰方肌轮廓取自 3D 模型。

text.aria-label: Psoas major is drawn schematically. — 腰大肌为示意画法。

text.tspan: Schematic; pathway and layers are simplified.
解剖示意；走行与层次经过简化。
